recommendation: Conduct comprehensive social needs assessment and resource connection
implementation_steps: Conduct comprehensive social needs assessments with focus on housing stability
Connect patients to housing resources, rental assistance, and benefits programs
Provide case management and care coordination across health and social service systems
Advocate for patients within healthcare and social service systems
Follow up to ensure successful connection to housing resources
evidence_summary: Social worker-led assessment and resource connection interventions have demonstrated improvements in housing stability, benefits enrollment, and health outcomes for patients experiencing housing insecurity.
